payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each hill/valley, try changing it to left or right neighbor and compute local new count to find maximum reduction; update total intimidation accordingly.
payload.rationale: The solution examines each hill/valley and locally tests two modifications, akin to pruning possibilities by only considering neighbor values, but lacks explicit branching or bounding. Forced to match complete_search subtypes, branch_and_bound is the closest candidate due to limited search space exploration.
